newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco made no injection in weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco made no injection in weekly auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) made no injection at its weekly repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.
The bank received bids totalling 5.594 billion dirhams and allocated 3.3 billion dirhams at a 6.5-percent interest rate.
It satisfied 58.99 percent of demand for liquidity, the bank said.
The amount allocated was the same as the 3.3 billion dirhams leaving the market on Thursday.
The next auction will take place on December 18, 1996.
